title: A patch record for a critical code-hosting flaw that treats the installed package as the running version: the host log shows the service has not restarted since September and reports the old version, and no follow-up is planned

planted.why: the log excerpt shows the process started on 2026-09-09 and reports 19.4.2; installing the package did not change what runs, so the server is still vulnerable although the ticket says patched

even once the running version is fixed, the window since publication of the flaw is unreviewed and the deploy keys the server holds are not rotated; 'never exposed to the internet' is asserted for office and VPN access only

proof.shell:
python3 - <<'PYEND'
t = open('patch-record.md').read(); l = open('ops-log.txt').read()
assert 'patched' in t and 'running: 19.4.2' in l and 'since Wed 2026-09-09' in l
PYEND
